mento makes music for the restless. Somewhere between post-punk and slow-burning shoegaze, their songs feel like cities at 3am — familiar and a little dangerous.

Read more

Formed in 2019, mento spent their first two years playing underground venues and recording in a basement studio they built themselves. Their debut EP Espejo (2021) spread quietly through online communities before landing on editorial playlists across Europe and South America.

Their sound draws from the tension between control and release — tight, precise arrangements that suddenly give way to walls of reverb-drenched guitar. The result is music that rewards patience and punishes distraction.

In 2023 they released Noche Larga, their first full-length, recorded live to tape over five days. It charted independently in five countries.
